Mistaken? No. No, absolutely not. I am one hundred percent completely certain they were changed. I know what I saw. 

Because I know how these portals work, you know? We use a similar electronic system at my clinic, and usually, everything leaves a trace. Functioning normally? Oh, yeah, absolutely. Everything was completely fine until about a year ago. That's when my dad's medical issues started getting worse and he had to start getting all these frequent labs and going to a million appointments. That's when I first started noticing the numbers being altered. 

Before that, everything was great. Work was fine, my personal life was fine. I actually had a lot more free time before all these appointments started. I used to go to this pottery class on Tuesday nights. It was so relaxing, just working with the clay. Although, the instructor, Brenda, was a little intense. She would hover over your shoulder and critique every little thing. "Your walls are too thick, your base isn't centered." It's like, Brenda, I'm making a bowl for my keys, not a masterpiece for the Louvre. She always wore these huge, chunky turquoise necklaces, too. Like, three of them at a time. They would clank against the pottery wheels when she leaned over. It drove me crazy. I actually stopped going because she kept trying to get everyone to buy into this essential oil pyramid scheme she was running on the side. She said peppermint oil could cure my dad's kidney issues. Can you believe that? Peppermint oil. As if I don't know how the renal system works. I draw blood for BUN and creatinine every single day.

He always wears these faded graphic tees with old video game logos on them, like Pac-Man or Atari. He told me once he has a whole room in his house just for his vintage arcade machines. His wife must hate that. My ex-boyfriend tried to do something like that with his comic books, just taking over the entire guest room. It smelled like old paper and dust all the time. I tried getting him to put a dehumidifier in there, but he said the noise bothered him while he was reading. It is just so exhausting. \n\nI feel like I really need a vacation to get away from it all for a few days. Have you ever been to Sedona? My cousin went to Sedona last spring and she said the red rocks are just beautiful. She brought me back this little cactus in a painted ceramic pot, but I accidentally overwatered it and it died. Cacti are supposed to be the easiest plants in the world to take care of, but I always manage to kill them. I think I just hover too much. I'm a hoverer. \n\nEven when I bake cookies, I pull up a chair right in front of the oven door and just watch them bake through the glass. I don't even set a timer anymore. I just watch them until the edges get perfectly golden brown. You have to take them out right exactly then, or they get too crunchy. I absolutely hate crunchy chocolate chip cookies. They should be soft and chewy in the middle, you know? My mom used to make the best cookies, and she'd put a slice of plain white sandwich bread in the Tupperware container to keep them soft.
